_comment: Commercial counterparties attached to pricing/availability/deployment offers. Upserted by slug. type uses provider_type enum verbatim. manufacturer_slug links an OEM provider to its manufacturer.

providers.name: 1X Technologies (direct)
providers.description: Direct OEM sales / preorder for the NEO home robot.

providers.name: Engineered Arts
providers.description: OEM sale (by quote) and event rental of Ameca.

providers.name: RobotShop EU
providers.description: Third-party multi-brand robotics retailer, not an OEM store. Listings verified per-SKU (price, availability) before use as commercial evidence.

providers.name: RobotShop US
providers.description: Third-party multi-brand robotics retailer, not an OEM store. US storefront, distinct from the EU one: it prices in USD and states tariff-inclusive pricing for the USA, so its offers must not be attached to robotshop-eu. Listings verified per-SKU (price, availability) before use as commercial evidence.

providers.name: reichelt elektronik
providers.description: German electronics distributor (reichelt.com), third-party seller, not an OEM store. Offers are attributed to its German storefront (region DE); listed prices include 19% German VAT.

providers.name: QUADRUPED Robotics
providers.description: German robotics distributor (quadruped.de), third-party seller, not an OEM store. Listed prices exclude 19% VAT.

providers.name: Robotoplus
providers.description: Bulgarian robotics integrator and reseller (Роботоплюс ООД, robotoplus.com), a third-party seller, not an OEM store. States on its own site that it is AGIBOT's appointed distributor for Bulgaria and Romania and that it delivers to Bulgaria, Romania, Greece and Cyprus. That authorization is SELF-DECLARED by the distributor and has not been confirmed on an AgiBot first-party source; do not present it as an officially verified AgiBot distributor. Offers are attributed only to BG and RO (the countries named in the appointment wording).

providers.name: Alza.cz
providers.description: Czech online electronics retailer (alza.cz), a third-party seller, not a manufacturer or an OEM store. Approved as a commercial provider and as a REFERENCE source for evidence-backed offers (owner decision 2026-10-05). Offers are attributed only to its Czech storefront (region CZ, currency CZK): no Slovak, Hungarian or EU-wide offer is inferred from Alza operating in other markets. NOT approved for automated monitoring, scheduled fetching, polling or automated price/stock checking: an Alza offer is a dated evidence snapshot, never a live price or live stock. New and used (bazaar) units are separate offers.
